en.headline: Government will not appeal court ruling on Fanling golf course housing EIA
en.dek: Authorities said they decided against further appeal after reviewing legal advice on the Court of Appeal judgment that upheld the quashing of environmental approval for 12,000 public flats.
body: The government announced on Thursday that it will not appeal a Court of Appeal ruling that upheld the earlier decision to quash the environmental impact assessment approval for a public housing project on part of the Fanling Golf Course.

A government spokesman said the decision was made after comprehensively considering legal advice. The Court of Appeal had earlier confirmed that the Director of Environmental Protection’s approval of the EIA report was flawed because of an inadequate public consultation process, improper conditions and shortcomings in meeting wildlife conservation objectives.

The project had been planned to provide about 12,000 public flats on 9.5 hectares of land resumed from the golf course. The government said it would review the future direction of the proposed development, including the impact of the unapproved EIA report on scale and timetable, and would announce the way forward in due course.
The Environmental Protection Department said it would study the legal guidance in the judgment carefully and apply the established principles when handling future EIA approvals.

zh.headline: 政府決定不就粉嶺高球場房屋環評判決再上訴
zh.dek: 政府經考慮法律意見後決定不上訴，上訴庭早前維持原訟庭裁決，撤銷環保署對約1.2萬伙公營房屋項目環評報告的批准。
body: 政府周四公布，決定不會就粉嶺高爾夫球場部分用地發展公營房屋的環境影響評估報告司法覆核案的上訴庭判決再提出上訴。
政府發言人表示，綜合考慮法律顧問意見並作審慎評估後作出決定。上訴庭早前維持原訟法庭裁決，認為環保署署長批准環評報告的過程存在問題，包括公眾諮詢不足、附加條件不當，以及未能充分符合野生動物保育目標。
該項目原計劃在收回的9.5公頃土地上興建約1.2萬個公營房屋單位。政府表示會檢視擬議公營房屋發展計劃的未來路向，包括考慮環評報告未獲批准對發展規模和時間的影響，並會適時交代。
環保署表示會仔細研究判詞提出的法律指引，日後執行環評審批工作時嚴格按照《環境影響評估條例》及法庭確立的原則，維持制度的合理性、合法性、透明度及公信力。
